purpose: Test only direct-to-device optimizer restoration: two fresh uninterrupted controls followed by one first/resume pair, with fresh A/A numerical variation, exact boundary checks and one resource-or-boundary stop.

smoke.resume_checkpoint: one full model plus optimizer/RNG/scheduler/cursor checkpoint after update 1
required: checkpoint byte receipt and model/runtime reload
restored scheduler, RNG, optimizer moments and data cursor
resume-start parameter hashes equal the first-process final hashes
all 381 tensors change in each process
native optimizer state step is 2 after resume

aa_envelope.name: aa-envelope-v1
aa_envelope.source: the two fresh uninterrupted arms only

stop_conditions: any A/A protocol or non-resume implementation mismatch
any update-1 loss or pre-clip gradient-norm mismatch
direct restore reports nonzero CPU optimizer staging

storage_policy.retention: retain exactly one diagnostic checkpoint and all run/failure/comparison reports; no automatic deletion and no promotion
storage_policy.historical_checkpoints: do not regenerate, overwrite or delete retired checkpoints

retention.smoke_checkpoint: retain exactly one diagnostic checkpoint for inspection; no promotion and no duplicate final model export
retention.sustained_weights: discard after before/after hashes; preserve only reports/profiles
retention.failures: preserve failure reports, profiles and guard logs
retention.historical_muon: reuse existing three-update evidence; do not rerun Muon

limitations: Short 55-token exposed diagnostic, not a long-context or broad workload benchmark.
Fresh A/A variation describes only this two-update numerical regime and does not retroactively qualify historical runs.
Exact parameter hashes and logits bytes remain separate from any numerical-equivalence interpretation.
Sampled memory telemetry can miss transient peaks.
The smoke checkpoint is required only for resume validation and is not a selected model.
No convergence, retention, learning-quality or RSI claim follows from this experiment.
